name: v0
tagline: AI that generates interfaces and apps
description: v0 is Vercel's AI app and interface builder, priced per user with monthly credits, plus a separate per-token API.
features: Monthly and daily credits per user
useCases: Generating UI and apps from prompts
strengths: New users get $5 in one-time credits
limitations: Free plan is limited to 7 messages per day

free.details: $5 in one-time credits for new users, a 7-message-per-day limit, Design Mode and GitHub sync.

api.summary: Per 1M tokens (input / cache write / cache read / output): v0 Mini $0.20 / $0.25 / $0.02 / $1.20; v0 Pro $2 / $2.50 / $0.20 / $10; v0 Max $5 / $6.25 / $0.50 / $25; v0 Max Fast $10 / $12.50 / $1 / $50.

pricing.regional: Prices are in USD and exclude VAT, GST and similar taxes; taxes are calculated from the billing address.

verification.notes: Product active. USD, excluding tax: Free $0 ($5 one-time credits for new users, 7 messages a day); Plus $30 per user/month ($30 of monthly credits plus $2 free daily credits; an unlabelled $90 figure sits beside it); Business $100 per user/month; Enterprise custom. Model token rates match the stored ones.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

keyFeature: Generates interfaces and apps with AI

profile.headline: An AI agent that builds real code, full-stack apps and agents from a prompt

capabilities.title: Build from a description
capabilities.text: Describe your idea in your preferred language, then ship features, refine designs, update copy and create live prototypes.

capabilities.title: Make interfaces from sketches
capabilities.text: Create high-fidelity UIs from wireframes or mockups.

capabilities.title: Deploy or open a pull request
capabilities.text: Deploy to Vercel infrastructure with one click, or open a pull request for review.

featureCards.name: Intelligent agent
featureCards.text: Can search the web, inspect sites, fix errors and connect external tools.

featureCards.name: Automatic error fixing
featureCards.text: Intelligent diagnostics for errors in your code.

featureCards.name: Real-time preview
featureCards.text: A live view of the app with visual progress for agent actions.

featureCards.name: Stack support
featureCards.text: Next.js, Tailwind and shadcn/ui, extensible with your own APIs, databases and components.
